title: _role
description: Roles are defined by each project, following this schema. The engine reads them through an adapter; the schema is independent of the Claude Code subagent format. Adapter: combines the role record with its `instructions` file to generate one markdown agent definition, written at the location Claude Code expects by convention. It runs as a build step, triggered manually, after the project has set up its role entities. Draft v0.

description.description: What the role is responsible for.

instructions.description: File describing how the role works.

approver.description: Permission setup only: the role allowed to approve this role's tasks. Null does not mean auto-approve; the approval flow is decided by the _workflow.
